purpose: The representative required checks Part 14 is measured on: Lockwell's ci.yml lanes at a pinned commit, on the host its GitHub runners used, under the same total allocation those runners had.

reference_host.description: netcup VPS (QEMU guest) that ran Lockwell's self-hosted runners and runs Sentinel's verification
reference_host.cgroup: v2, systemd user manager with cpu, memory and pids delegated (loginctl enable-linger)

allocation.note: The lockwell-ci runner slice's caps (cpu.max 10 CPUs, memory.max 26 GiB). A lane measured alone gets the whole allocation; lanes measured together share it. Every runtime compared gets the same caps: podman --cpus/--memory/--memory-swap, or a systemd user scope with CPUQuota/MemoryMax/MemorySwapMax=0.

tools.gcc: 14.2.0 (in the go image; the race detector needs cgo)

rules: Every required test executes on every sample: -count=1 is part of each command and no test result is ever reused.
The race detector, both 30-second fuzz budgets, the integration suite in its own process and every package in the lane stay as they are in ci.yml.
A sample counts only when the lane exits 0; a failing sample aborts the record.

A record belongs to one contract revision (the BLAKE3 digest of this file is in the record). Changing a source commit, image digest, tool version, command, allocation or condition procedure makes a new revision; records of another revision are never compared with it.
Comparisons use records taken on the reference host with CPU pressure (some, avg60) under 5 % at the start; a contended start is discarded, not recorded.

cold.description: Sources checked out at the pinned commits, the image present; Go build cache, module cache and tool binaries empty (Go makes its module cache read-only, so it is made writable first). Modules missing from the checked-in .goproxy come from proxy.golang.org, as they do in CI after a miss: a cold sample depends on the network. Image pull is measured separately, never inside a lane.
cold.prepare: chmod -R u+w {root}/cache 2>/dev/null; rm -rf {root}/cache/gocache {root}/cache/gomodcache {root}/cache/gopath {root}/tmp && mkdir -p {root}/cache/gocache {root}/cache/gomodcache {root}/cache/gopath {root}/tmp {root}/home && git -C {root}/src/lockwell checkout -q -f {commit:lockwell} && git -C {root}/src/lockwell clean -qfdx

warm.description: Unchanged source at the pinned commit; caches kept from the previous sample of the same lane (one unrecorded warm-up primes them). Tests still execute.

small-edit.description: Warm caches, then a fresh small edit per sample: an inert unexported declaration appended to internal/s3/cors.go, different each sample, so the package recompiles and every dependent test binary relinks.
small-edit.prepare: mkdir -p {root}/cache/gocache {root}/cache/gomodcache {root}/cache/gopath {root}/tmp {root}/home && git -C {root}/src/lockwell checkout -q -f {commit:lockwell} && git -C {root}/src/lockwell clean -qfdx -e .goproxy && printf '\nvar _ = %d // sentinel-bench small edit\n' {sample_nonce} >> {root}/src/lockwell/internal/s3/cors.go

lanes.run: go vet ./... && go build ./cmd/... && go run ./cmd/lockwell --help >/dev/null && go run ./cmd/lockwelld --help >/dev/null

not_measured.reason: installs pinned tools from the network on a miss; measured once tools are prebuilt into the image (B04), not before
govulncheck reads the live vulnerability database: not reproducible between samples
Docker/Compose lifecycle; an optional compatibility lane (lockwell-migration.md), kept external
Node or browser toolchains and advisory steps; measured with B05 and B06
long scopes reported separately, never inside the sub-minute target
